name: Neoaetosauroides
sum: Neoaetosauroides is a primitive aetosaur from the Late Triassic Los Colorados Formation of Argentina.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; named by Bonaparte in 1969.
material: Several individuals; one of the best-represented aetosaurs of South America, and the first aetosaur known from the Los Colorados Formation.
biology: Biomechanical studies of its skull suggest a diet that differed greatly from that of most aetosaurs; its upper tooth row reached the snout tip, which argues against a keratinous beak.
author: Bonaparte 1969

sources.text: R. L. Carroll. 1988. Vertebrate Paleontology and Evolution.
